concepts.title: CI Workflow (ci.yml)
concepts.description: Template CI workflow running lint, type-check and test on push/PR to main and dev.
concepts.notes: name CI | triggers push[main,dev] + pull_request[main,dev] | concurrency group github.workflow-github.ref cancel-in-progress true | single job validate on ubuntu-latest | steps actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4 (node-version and cache from placeholder keys NODE_VERSION / PACKAGE_MANAGER), install --frozen-lockfile, LINT_COMMAND, TYPE_CHECK_COMMAND, TEST_COMMAND | build job present but fully commented out | GATES: NO — file is not valid YAML as shipped: python yaml.safe_load fails with 'expected <block end>, but found <scalar>' at line 39 col 34 because unquoted {{PACKAGE_MANAGER}} in `run:` parses as a YAML flow mapping; GitHub Actions rejects the workflow so it never runs and cannot block a PR | placeholders must be substituted by scripts/setup-template.sh before the workflow is loadable | config KEY NAMES only: NODE_VERSION, PACKAGE_MANAGER, LINT_COMMAND, TYPE_CHECK_COMMAND, TEST_COMMAND | DOC DRIFT: docs/ci-cd/CI-CD-Pipeline-Guide.md lists the repo's core workflows as .github/workflows/multi-team-collaboration.yml and .github/workflows/branch-protection.yml; neither file exists — the four real files are ci.yml, docker-build.yml, pr-validation.yml, test-fork-sync.yml

concepts.title: Docker Build Workflow (docker-build.yml)
concepts.description: Builds and pushes a container image on push to main/dev or on a labeled PR.
concepts.notes: name Docker Build | triggers push[main,dev] + pull_request types[labeled] | job build guarded by if: event_name == push OR (pull_request AND labels contains 'build-docker-image') | permissions contents:read packages:write | steps checkout@v4, docker/setup-buildx-action@v3, docker/login-action@v3 (username github.actor, password secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN), docker/metadata-action@v5, docker/build-push-action@v5 with push:true, cache-from/cache-to type=gha mode=max, then an echo-only 'Image digest' step | tag rules: type=ref event=pr prefix=pr-, type=ref event=branch, type=raw latest enabled only when github.ref == refs/heads/main, type=sha prefix=sha- | GATES: technically yes (a build failure fails the check) but it is opt-in for PRs — an unlabeled PR never runs it, so it gates nothing by default | valid YAML | config KEY NAMES only: env REGISTRY, env IMAGE_NAME (both unsubstituted template placeholders), secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN | failure modes: unsubstituted REGISTRY/IMAGE_NAME make login and push fail; no Dockerfile in repo root at BASELINE_SHA | DOC DRIFT: final step prints a pull command using ${{ github.sha }} as the tag, but metadata-action emits sha tags with prefix sha-, so the printed command references a tag that was never pushed

concepts.title: PR Validation Workflow (pr-validation.yml)
concepts.description: Checks PR rebase status, commit message format, PR title and Linear ticket reference.
concepts.notes: name PR Validation | trigger pull_request types [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited] | single job validate-pr on ubuntu-latest | checkout@v4 with fetch-depth 0 | four run steps | step 1 rebase check: git fetch origin base_ref, compares rev-parse origin/<base> to merge-base HEAD origin/<base>, emits ::error:: and exit 1 on mismatch — THIS IS THE ONLY HARD GATE in the file | step 2 commit message check: git log --format=%s base..HEAD piped into a while-read subshell, grep -qE for conventional-commit + [{{TICKET_PREFIX}}-N], allowlists ^Merge and ^🤖 Generated, emits ::warning:: only — never exits nonzero; also the loop runs in a pipeline subshell so no status could escape it anyway | step 3 PR title check: ::warning:: only | step 4 Linear ticket reference in PR body via env PR_BODY: ::warning:: only | GATES: rebase only; commit format, PR title and ticket reference are advisory and cannot fail the run | config KEY NAME only: TICKET_PREFIX (unsubstituted placeholder — until substituted the regexes match the literal string {{TICKET_PREFIX}}, so every real commit warns) | DOC DRIFT: docs/ci-cd/CI-CD-Pipeline-Guide.md Stage 1 says branch-name and PR-title violations 'block PR progression'; the implementation only warns, and there is no branch-name check at all in this workflow

concepts.title: Fork Sync Compatibility Workflow (test-fork-sync.yml)
concepts.description: Path-filtered workflow running the fork-sync and sync unit test suites against fixture manifests.
concepts.notes: name Fork Sync Compatibility | triggers push[main] and pull_request[main], both path-filtered to scripts/sync-claude-harness.sh, .harness-manifest.schema.json, tests/fixtures/sync/**, tests/test-fork-sync.sh, and the workflow file itself | job fork-sync-compat, ubuntu-latest, timeout-minutes 10 | steps checkout@v4, setup-node@v4 node 20, setup-python@v5 python 3.11, pip install pyyaml, bash tests/test-fork-sync.sh, then a combined step running test-manifest-loader.sh, test-rename-diff.sh, test-substitutions.sh, test-protected-files.sh, test-preflight.sh each with '|| exit 1' | GATES: YES — the only workflow in the repo that runs real assertions and fails the check, but only for PRs that touch a path in the filter; a PR that changes only .claude/ or docs/ triggers no gating workflow at all | exercises sync --dry-run against fork manifest fixtures (rendertrust, keryk-ai per header comment) | failure modes: path filter miss (silent pass), 10-minute timeout, missing pyyaml | UNKNOWN: whether any of these checks are configured as required status checks in GitHub branch protection — branch protection is not declared in-repo, only described as a manual gh api call in docs/ci-cd/CI-CD-Pipeline-Guide.md | 3 of 9 scripts in tests/ are never invoked by this workflow: test-manifest-init.sh, test-multi-domain-sync.sh, test-patch-generation.sh

concepts.title: Harness Release Changelog Process
concepts.description: How harness releases are described: generate-changelog.sh diffs two refs into the HARNESS_CHANGELOG.yml schema.
concepts.notes: scripts/generate-changelog.sh, bash, set -euo pipefail, 18695 bytes | CLI: --from <ref> --to <ref> required, --format yaml|markdown (default yaml), --version, --summary, --help | functions usage, die, info, warn, validate_ref, classify_file, status_to_change_type, is_breaking, generate_description, yaml_quote, parse_args, collect_changes, emit_yaml, emit_markdown, main | data source is a single command: git -C PROJECT_ROOT diff --name-status -M FROM_REF TO_REF -- .claude/ — scope is .claude/ ONLY, nothing else in the repo is ever categorized | PROJECT_ROOT derived from BASH_SOURCE dirname/.. | categories NEW_FILE, UPDATED_FILE, METHODOLOGY, BREAKING, CONFIG; renames and deletions override to BREAKING | writes to STDOUT only — it never opens or edits HARNESS_CHANGELOG.yml; info/warn/die go to stderr | color codes disabled when stdout is not a tty | HARNESS_CHANGELOG.yml is schema documentation plus one large commented-out example: schema_version 1.0.0, generated_at set, and releases: [] — the file contains ZERO real release entries at BASELINE_SHA | DOC DRIFT: HARNESS_CHANGELOG.yml header says it is 'Consumed by sync-claude-harness.sh for automated categorization'; grep across scripts/ and .claude/ finds no reference to HARNESS_CHANGELOG in sync-claude-harness.sh or anywhere but generate-changelog.sh's own comments and emitted headers — no consumer exists | DOC DRIFT: docs/release/PRE-RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md requires 'HARNESS_CHANGELOG.yml updated for this release', but shipped releases v2.6.0 and v2.9.0 instead have standalone docs/releases/*-STRUCTURED-CHANGELOG.md files and the yml stayed empty | v2.6.0 changelog states it was retroactively generated by this script then manually enriched

concepts.notes: map-card for docs/release/PRE-RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md | header declares MANDATORY, release blocked until every item resolves | release info block: version, release branch main, previous version, Linear epic/stories, release owner, date | 8 numbered sections (grep -c '^## ' returns 11 headings: 8 numbered plus Release Information, Sign-Off, Notes / Errata): 1 Code Quality Gates, 2 Documentation Completeness, 3 Third-Party Integration Verification, 4 SAFe Workflow Gates, 5 Template Compatibility, 6 Backward Compatibility, 7 Release Artifacts, 8 Post-Release Verification | section 7 covers git tag -a, git push origin main --tags, GitHub Release creation | section 8 verifies via gh release view and requires git branch --list 'SAW-*' to return empty | section 1 names bash -n on scripts/sync-claude-harness.sh, all 8 test suites by filename with pass counts, a grep for conflict markers, shellcheck scripts/*.sh | section 3 requires vendor-doc verification for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini and forbids fabricated config formats | section 4 lists non-collapsible QAS and Security Engineer gates plus System Architect Stage 1 | enforcement is human checkbox only — no hook, script or workflow in the repo reads this file | DOC DRIFT: section 1 enumerates 8 test suites but the CI workflow test-fork-sync.yml runs only 6 of them (omits test-patch-generation.sh and test-manifest-init.sh), so the checklist's suites are not CI-verified | section 2 requires HARNESS_CHANGELOG.yml be updated for the release or generated via generate-changelog.sh, but the file's releases: key is [] at BASELINE_SHA, so this item has never actually been satisfied

concepts.notes: project_workflow/ contains exactly 5 files, listed: CONTRIBUTING.md, scripts/setup-ci-cd.sh, .github/CODEOWNERS, .github/pull_request_template.md, .github/workflows/main.yml | nothing under project_workflow/ is active in this repo — GitHub only reads workflows from the repo-root .github/workflows/, so main.yml here never runs | setup-ci-cd.sh does NOT copy these files anywhere: it checks gh is installed and authenticated (exit 1 otherwise), reads owner/name via gh repo view --json, manages secrets via check_secret/gh secret list, PUTs branch-protection rules through gh api (tolerating failure with a warning when admin access is missing), then merely VERIFIES that .github/workflows/main.yml, .github/CODEOWNERS and .github/pull_request_template.md exist in the CURRENT working directory and prints missing ones, and finally runs `yarn ci:validate` only when a package.json is present | main.yml name 'Multi-Team Collaboration Pipeline', triggers pull_request[__PRIMARY_DEV_BRANCH__] types [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review], push[__PRIMARY_DEV_BRANCH__], workflow_dispatch | env KEY NAMES only: NODE_VERSION, YARN_CACHE_FOLDER | job validate-structure outputs branch-valid and linear-ticket; steps validate branch naming against ^__TICKET_PREFIX__-[0-9]+-[a-z0-9-]+$ and extract the Linear ticket, exiting nonzero on mismatch — this scaffold DOES gate on branch name, unlike the installed .github/workflows/pr-validation.yml | placeholder dialect differs from the rest of the repo: project_workflow uses __TICKET_PREFIX__ / __PRIMARY_DEV_BRANCH__ double-underscore tokens while everything else uses {{TICKET_PREFIX}} mustache tokens, so scripts/setup-template.sh substitution does not reach it | project_workflow/CONTRIBUTING.md mixes both dialects: 'Contributing to **PROJECT_NAME**' bare, {{PROJECT_SHORT}} mustache, and __TICKET_PREFIX__ underscore, in the same file | main.yml line 20 uses `if: github.event_name == "pull_request"` with double quotes; GitHub Actions expressions require single-quoted strings, so this condition is a syntax error and the job would not evaluate as written | setup-ci-cd.sh performs NO placeholder substitution at all, so the __TICKET_PREFIX__ / __PRIMARY_DEV_BRANCH__ tokens in main.yml survive its run untouched | UNKNOWN: which script or documented step actually copies project_workflow/ into a fork and substitutes its double-underscore tokens — no in-repo caller references the directory
